dataList.content:
Jia Qiu does not give us even a moment to catch our breath; the unrelenting storm of strikes pummels Hong Lu and the rest of us to the ground. But he doesn't seem even remotely winded by that effort.
一直猛烈攻击我们，压制着鸿璐的贾丘……未曾动摇。
dataList.place:

dataList.content:
But I could tell that this wasn't his full force; he wasn't looking to kill us here outright.
但我可以清晰地感受到他未尽全力，并非真心想杀死我们。

Jia Qiu awaits Hong Lu's answer...
贾丘仍在等待鸿璐的答案。

... but it seemed that his patience was running low.
但……他看起来似乎不愿再给鸿璐更多的时间。

If you're going to toy with them, why don't you at least hit them harder, hm?
既然要杀……就不能杀得痛快点吗？

I would love to watch you tear his useless head from his torso.
砍下他那没用的脑袋也不坏吧。

Regardless of Jia Huan's snide remarks, Jia Qiu only looked down wordlessly at Hong Lu, who was still trying to catch his breath.
无视了贾环的嘲笑，贾丘无言地俯视着气息凌乱的鸿璐。

... You have no answers, still?
……你仍没有答案吗。

Hong Lu's eyes wander, like someone swimming through veils of time.
如同于时间中彷徨之人一般，鸿璐的眼睛动了。

What Hongyuan needs...
鸿园所需要的……

But the silence continues, letting the countless moments in time to pass by unseen.
在其间，似乎有许多光景从中掠过，沉默仍在继续。

Don't pretend like you are ruminating upon some great secret of the world.
何必装出一副很苦恼的样子呢？

None of this matters to you. Hongyuan, Hierarch... why should any of that matter when all you care about is but a singular thing?
鸿园也好家主也罢，实际上你关心的也只有一样吧。

You want someone to end your life. To cut off your head.
你只关心谁能替你砍下自己的头。

But oh, you don't even possess the courage to do the deed yourself, nor do you have the persistence to struggle on.
毕竟你既没有自绝的勇气，也没有继续战斗下去的想法。

Jia Baoyu... what is true greed, if not that?
可那就是你的……贪婪啊，你难道不清楚吗，贾宝玉？

... Why didn't you save him?
……你为什么没有救他？
dataList.place:

dataList.content:
No, let me ask you a different question.
不。让我换个问题。

Why did you save her... and only her, Jia Baoyu?!
为什么你只救了她……贾宝玉！

Lin Daiyu—she was also supposed to be there at the event. With the Kong family.
林黛玉，那孩子应该和你一起去孔家集会的地方的。

But instead, she alone was found hiding in some shed far, far from that building, wasn't she?
可是那天，那孩子却一个人藏在远离建筑的仓库里，对吧？

Jia Huan, he...
贾环他……

He always envied you. You knew that. You must've.
一直都很羡慕你，你也知道吧。

His future in Daguanyuan was more precious than anything you could've ever done, anything you ever could've been! More than this dull, meaningless life you cling to!
在这大观园里，那孩子此后的未来本将是珍贵的，和你这愚昧的人生根本无法比较！

Brother.
哥哥。

Humans die. It's what they're born to do.
人终有一死。

It's naive to wish for an eternal blossom.
希望花永远绽放是不可能的。

Because everything that blooms is destined to wilt away.
时机到来，它自然会凋零。

Hong Lu stops himself. The sudden reemergence of this memory has put his reply to sleep, still and silent.
鸿璐本想说些什么，但随着记忆的浮现，他半张的嘴又再度闭上了……
dataList.place:

dataList.content:
And the familiar, aloof, and cloud-like words fill the vacuum.
那其中如往常一般……拼凑着如浮云般含糊不清的词句。

Even if an answer to your question exists, what meaning would it have?
即便真有这样的答案存在，它还有什么意义呢？

In our lives that are but sparks that go out in the blink of an eye, what meaning would all this suffering, happiness, pain, and sorrow have? They'll all float away with the flow anyway.
这所有的一切都刹那即过，这其中的苦痛哀喜终将流逝。

So... if Hongyuan needs anything, I guess, it might need to find something like... contentment in poverty and the joy of having principles.
(安貧樂道)
所以……如果说鸿园有什么需要的，那应该是安贫乐道吧。

To not desire more, nor to discard what is given to us... and instead, to simply and fully accept the present. That must be the remorseless path to true inner peace, right?
对所得的不再奢望，也不去舍弃……只有坦然去接受，才是无悔地通向平安的路。

"Even in poverty-stricken lives, if one finds contentment with what is given to them, they will find inner peace," I see.
即便生活贫困，只要满足于现下，心灵便得平安，对吧。

However, Jia Baoyu... I must doubt the truthfulness behind your words. For you... do not know poverty.
但，贾宝玉。我不认为你是真的在谈论贫困。你……不知道什么是贫困吧。

If you knew true poverty, you would also know that it is not something to be uttered so lightly with that insouciant smile of yours. None of us here in Daguanyuan, neither you nor I, deserve to discuss it in the manner with which you have.
你若真的了解什么是贫困，就会知道贫困并非能由你面带那副浅笑随便说起。你我如此，这座大观园里的所有人也是一样。

Thus, I am compelled to believe that you are still yet to give me a real answer.
因此我仍不认为这是出自你真心的回答。

... He's right.
……他是对的。

You want us to just accept what's given to us... that it just is what it is...? That's too wretched and pathetic for the poor.
接受所被给予的东西……这对穷人而言是非常痛苦、悲惨的事情。

Shadow draws over Jia Qiu's expression as though he observes every hour that has been slipping through Hong Lu's fingers.
仿佛也一同目睹了鸿璐所经过的时间，贾丘的脸被深深的阴影笼罩。

And he... remains patient. It seemed as though he was waiting for a reply he thought Hong Lu must rightly give.
他似乎……在耐心地等待鸿璐说出他应说的话。

I will ask again.
再问你一次。

What does Hongyuan need?
鸿园所需要的究竟为何。

What is it that its people need—those who are too busy dying, too busy living, too busy simply persisting, breathing?
那些只会不断呼吸、不断追逐生死的人所需要的东西。

What Hongyuan needs is...
鸿园所需要的……

The silence has grown.
比此前更长的沉默从二人之间流过。

Hong Lu's mouth opens and shuts, once again caging the words that ache to be let out.

dataList.content:
And his lips once again assume the familiar arch.
而他的嘴又弯成了熟悉的平滑的曲线。

The same, lonely smile that has seen far too many things they care about float away.
是那目睹无数珍惜之物从眼前流逝的，寂寞的微笑。

Hongyuan needs...
鸿园所需要的……

... a long life expectancy, fortune, and health in both body and spirit.
(壽福康寧)
是寿福康宁吧。

Wouldn't it be nice to live a long, fortunate life, free from any inequities of the world from the beginning to the end of your existence?
享受着长寿、幸福的人生，过着安定的生活。

You spew such hollow, worthless lies in place of the truth that you so nearly uttered.
你把要出口的话又吞了回去，代之以虚有其表的谎言。

Let it out. Your truth.
把你本来想说的说出来。

That is what I wish to hear.
那才是我想听到的东西。

To be content with what is given to us, and to live a long life unburdened by sickness and worry on account of inequities...
满足于所得的生活，无忧无虑的健康生活。

They may both be answers, indeed.
你此前所提到过的也许都能作为答案。

If they were, truly, replies risen from the fathoms of your heart, then I would have accepted them and thereby drawn my conclusions.
若那些话真的是从你心底得出的答案，我会接受它们，得出结论。

Yet...
但……
I am yet to hear your answer. 我还没有听到你的答案。

That answer, hiding in the shadows of your hesitation.
你那犹豫之后，还是没能说出口的话。

The answer that you buried deep within.
你所深埋的那句话。

My lord, while there is effort, he is—
主公。虽然他已在努力表达自己的想法，但……

Withdraw now, Zilu. It seems that a brutal winter must come afore I am to estimate the green within him.
退下吧，子路。若无一场严冬，便无法测度弟弟的苍翠。

Reflect upon yourself! Exhume your humanity, your righteousness from deep within!
继续探求你的内心。将你深埋着的仁义，显露在我面前。
